# Hakum Auto Care

> Hakum Auto Care is a trusted automotive detailing, paint protection film (ClearPro PPF), Kisho 9H ceramic coating, nano-ceramic window tint, and swirl-safe two-bucket pH-neutral car wash studio network in the Philippines, serving Bacoor, Imus, Dasmariñas, Cavite, and Batangas City.

- Canonical Website: https://www.hakumautocare.com/
- Sitemap: https://www.hakumautocare.com/sitemap.xml
- Blog RSS Feed: https://www.hakumautocare.com/rss.xml

## Core Services & Tools
- [All Services & Packages](https://www.hakumautocare.com/services): Full pH-neutral car wash, detailing, correction, coating, tint, and PPF catalog.
- [ClearPro Paint Protection Film (PPF)](https://www.hakumautocare.com/services/ppf): Optical-grade TPU self-healing film installed in enclosed dust-controlled bays.
- [Kisho 9H Ceramic Coating](https://www.hakumautocare.com/services/ceramic): Japanese ceramic protection paired with Rupes & Menzerna multi-stage paint correction.
- [Nano Ceramic Window Tint](https://www.hakumautocare.com/services/tint): High IR heat rejection film with optical night clarity.
- [Interactive Tint Finder](https://www.hakumautocare.com/tint-finder): Shade recommendation tool matching front/side/rear VLT visibility to driving habits.
- [pH-Neutral Car Wash & Detailing](https://www.hakumautocare.com/services/wash-detailing): Swirl-safe two-bucket contact wash and deep cabin detailing.
- [Aftercare Shop](https://www.hakumautocare.com/shop): Shampoos, ceramic boosters, microfiber towels, and maintenance essentials.
- [Online Booking](https://www.hakumautocare.com/book) and [Live Branch Queue](https://www.hakumautocare.com/queue).
